thread:
maria: Quick note from last week's postmortem: customers couldn't map fallback rows to events because our decision payloads weren't keyed consistently. Need a compact stable key and retention story.

jon: Agreed. Propose a 2-part token: fb:<decid>[:p] where :p is optional parent id. Short decids (8 chars) so they fit in logs and headers.

eme: UX: console should allow copy-to-clipboard of token and a one-click "open in eventstore" action. Don't show full JSON inline by default.

rachel: For privacy we must ensure headers NEVER contain prompt text. Headers can carry only token + small codes. Anything human-readable goes to eventstore with org-scoped access controls.

ops-bot: :information_source: feature-flag plan: "fallback.tokens.header" -> internal orgs for 1w. Eventstore retention defaults to 90d for hosted, org-overrides available.

maria: Also discuss sampling: we can't surface every fallback in the UI for high-volume routes. Suggest UI sampling_rate field and an option for "show recent examples" which uses tail-sampling.

jon: Telemetry: emit counter.fallbacks and gauge.fallback_active with tags: policy, trigger_code, from_variant, to_variant, sampled=true/false. Make decision_id a tag for traceability.

eme: API debate: header vs body. I prefer header because it's visible in dev tools, but header must be small and opt-in. For SDKs we can add a debug param that returns the token in response metadata instead of header.

rachel: Add opt-out at API key level. Some enterprise customers won't want any debug headers emitted. Also allow private deployments to disable by default.

maria: Storage: full fallback payload should include parent_decision_id, operator_override (who+reason+ttl), config_delta (diff), and raw_trigger where allowed. Use protobuf for eventstore to save space.

jon: Implementation detail: generate decids in runtime central service so all runtimes use same algorithm. Use hop-resilient id: hash(request_id || policy_version || minute_bucket) -> base36(8).

eme: Frontend: add column "FB" with token and pill showing trigger_code. Expand opens side panel with event link, model digests, and operator actions. Default collapsed.

rachel: For chained fallbacks, show breadcrumbs with times. Include small graph view in panel. Parent ids make that easy.

ops-bot: :bell: rollout-schedule: staging gate opens 2026-03-28. Flag names: rw.fallback.header.token, rw.fallback.ui.sample.

maria: Tests: unit for id generation, e2e to assert header present only when flag ON and API key allowed, UI test for copy/open, and perf test to measure header overhead at 1k rps.

jon: One more: add a lightweight cli tool `rw-fb-inspect <token>` that queries eventstore and prints summary. Useful for support.

eme: Love cli idea. Will add to devex backlog.

rachel: I'll draft small microcopy for UI and opt-out docs.

maria: Cool. I'll write RFC with header format examples, proto schema, and retention defaults. Tagging @eng-sre and @support for reviews.
